answer_1.quote: In this work, we test a wide variety of DA approaches, both the ones found in the literature as well as our own approach, on four different tasks: Zero-shot EL with ZESHEL dataset, QC with TREC database, STS with STS-B dataset, and multilingual STS with mSTS database.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates synthetic textual data through various data augmentation techniques, including paraphrasing, back-translation, and GAN-based generation, which are forms of natural language generation.

answer_2.quote: For ZESHEL we use recall@k, for TREC F1 score, for STS-B and mSTS the spearman's rank correlation (SRC) between the cosine similarity of sentence pairs embeddings and ground-truth labels.
